experiment_data.hypothesis: Cross-environment validation of C3 (unexposed dt_emb protection) on Cheetah Run, seed=0. If unexposed dt_emb (trained but subsample OFF, gate_subsample_max_dt=1) prevents CIVO in Cheetah as it does in Walker (008a: 3/3 healthy, NVE 0.43-0.93x), this strengthens the causal claim that multi-rate data exposure is the necessary CIVO trigger across environments.
